comment: The exact Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime Evergreen Standalone Installer embedded in the Qronos NSIS installer. The build never downloads it: a developer fetches the pinned URL into .cache/wv2/ once, and build_support.build_desktop verifies these bytes offline before every build. Re-pinning is a reviewed change. Redistribution terms and installer signing are owner gates, not approvals recorded here.
component: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime Evergreen Standalone Installer

runtime.evidence: Declared for this appId by OfflineManifest.gup inside the installer's embedded payload (package MicrosoftEdgeWebview_X64_154.0.4258.62.exe, action needsadmin=prefers).

authenticode.verifiedWith: signtool verify /pa /v, Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, 2026-10-08: Successfully verified

ownerGates: Microsoft's redistribution terms for the WebView2 Runtime and its Evergreen Standalone Installer have not been reviewed or accepted by the owner; embedding it is a technical packaging choice, not redistribution clearance.
The Qronos installer that embeds it is unsigned; Authenticode signing of the Qronos installer is a separate owner gate.

This pinned runtime version ages. Once installed, the Evergreen runtime is updated by Microsoft when the machine is online; fresh offline installs receive this version until the pin is reviewed and replaced.
